snippet.title: Chicken Simulator - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the last chicken standing game! Can you compete with other chickens to cross the road and stay alive?
Play at GooglePlay: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.funnygames.chickenroad
